description: This is a PHP source file defining the LocalizationDao class, which interacts with the database to manage localization-related entities such as languages, translations, error records, and groups for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocalizationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for performing database operations related to localization entities within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages based on provided filter parameters and returns an array of matching language records.

methods.name: getLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of language records matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns an array of language IDs that exist from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: saveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Persists a new or updated I18NLanguage entity to the database.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Fetches translations in a normalized array form for given filter criteria.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslationsForExport
methods.description: Retrieves translations formatted for export, including additional metadata like version and unit ID.

methods.name: getTranslationsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of translations matching filter criteria.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedLangString
methods.description: Updates existing translations and adds new ones in bulk.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStrings
methods.description: Persists an array of import error records related to language strings.

methods.name: getImportErrorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of import errors based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getImportErrorCount
methods.description: Counts import error records matching specific filters.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes import error records for specific language strings in a language.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLanguageAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes import error records for a specific language and employee number.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for localization groups based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the count of groups matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Fetches a group entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Marks given language IDs as removed by updating their 'added' status.

methods.name: getLangStringById
methods.description: Retrieves a language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Fetches a language string entity based on its unit ID and associated group ID.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NError entity by its name.
